instruction:
Using Obsidian, you should create a new note named "Journal/2026-03-15.md" and then set its content to exactly the following:

# 2026-03-15

Quiet afternoon. Cleared inbox notes and planned next week.
reference_command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# 2026-03-15

Quiet afternoon. Cleared inbox notes and planned next week.
'); obsidian-cli create "Journal/2026-03-15.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

parameters.expected_content:
# 2026-03-15

Quiet afternoon. Cleared inbox notes and planned next week.
